Biological Diversity Act, 2002.fact: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 is an Act by the Parliament of India for the preservation of biological diversity in India, and provides the mechanism for equitable sharing of benefits arising out of the use of traditional biological resources and knowledge.

Biological interaction.subject: Environment & Ecology
Biological interaction.question: The _____ was Effect that organisms have on other organisms.
Biological interaction.fact: In ecology, a biological interaction is the effect that a pair of organisms living together in a community have on each other. Biological interactions range from mutualism, beneficial to both partners, to competition, harmful to both partners.

Biological membrane.subject: Environment & Ecology
Biological membrane.question: The _____ was Enclosing or separating membrane in organisms acting as selective semi-permeable barrier.
Biological membrane.fact: A biological membrane or biomembrane is a selectively permeable membrane that separates the interior of a cell from the external environment or creates intracellular compartments by serving as a boundary between one part of the cell and another. Biological membranes, in the form of eukaryotic cell membranes, consist of a phospholipid bilayer with embedded, integral and peripheral proteins used in communication and transportation of chemicals and ions.

Biological organisation.subject: Environment & Ecology
Biological organisation.question: The _____ was Hierarchy of complex structures and systems within biological sciences.
Biological organisation.fact: Biological organization is the organization of complex biological structures and systems that define life using a reductionistic approach. The traditional hierarchy, as detailed below, extends from atoms to biospheres.

Biological process.subject: Environment & Ecology
Biological process.question: The _____ was Any function vital to living organisms.
Biological process.fact: A biological process is a process necessary for an organism to live, and therefore shapes its capacity to interact with its environment. Biological processes are made of many chemical reactions or other events that are involved in the persistence and transformation of life forms.

Biological pump.subject: Environment & Ecology
Biological pump.question: The _____ was Carbon capture process in oceans.
Biological pump.fact: The biological pump (or marine biological carbon pump) is the ocean's biologically driven sequestration of carbon from the atmosphere and land runoff to the ocean interior and seafloor sediments. The biological pump is the biological component of the "marine carbon pump" which contains both a physical and biological component.
